Artemis II Launch 27 Images 1 Video Go To Gallery Go To Gallery Space Launch System Orion Spacecraft Exploration Ground Systems SLS (Space Launch System) Rocket NASA’s Artemis rocket is the SLS (Space Launch System), a super heavy‑lift rocket that uses solid rocket boosters derived from the space shuttle and liquid-fueled engines attached to a new central core stage. SLS provides the power needed to lift the Orion spacecraft off Earth and send it into deep space. NASA’s SLS (Space Launch System) rocket, with the Orion spacecraft aboard, is seen atop the mobile launcher at Launch Pad 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida on Aug. 30, 2022. NASA/Eric Bordelon Orion Spacecraft The Orion spacecraft is specifically designed to carry astronauts on deep space exploration missions farther than ever before.
